disposition: Engineering completed for the pure quota gate (procedure_003, unit level). No quota source was read, no native session ran and nothing was launched; T006 wires the gate into the native transport.

executedChecks.scope: Run by Claude subagents (not independent review); the quality review applied 17 mutations to a scratch copy and all were caught. Applied: settle refuses a post-reading not strictly after the pre-reading and a pre-to-post span above MAX_READING_SPAN (30-minute F3/NC-8 session plus two freshness intervals); settle and settle_probe stop on reading-level stop conditions shown by the post-reading; strict UTC instant pattern (date-only, week-date, basic-format and offset stamps refuse instead of raising); executionAuthorization not settable by the constructor; reasons name the rule, not its number; an invalid probe count is a refusal like invalid cohort state; ast-based purity test; caps and rule text bound to both founder records; closure callbacks typed and return no reason.

limits: Pure function over caller-supplied readings, clock and cohort state: it proves only that the gate decides correctly on its inputs, not that the orchestrator read the usage card, read it at the stated time or copied it faithfully; readings are self-asserted. Per-session use is attributed from plan-level percentages (integer, as shown by the usage card), so another consumer of the same plan during a session is charged to it, and sub-percent use is invisible. A window reset between readings, a post-reading not after the pre-reading, or a span above MAX_READING_SPAN stops rather than estimating. Cohort state (units used, cohort weekly percent) is owned and stored by SPEC-049; settle reports the updated state but does not persist it. Live-probe caps (NC-10) are kept separate from the D2 cohort caps; the reading-level stops (weekly above 80 %, extra usage, 5-hour at or above 90 %) apply to both. Rule values that the founder records give only in prose (80 %, 90 %, 10 %) are bound by text match. Synthetic readings only; no host, model, network, quota source or native activation. Pre-PR reviews were Claude subagents, not independent review.
outcome: agent_braid/harness_quota.py provides admit and settle for D2 cohort units and admit_probe and settle_probe for NC-10 live probes. Each takes the NC-6 usage-card reading(s) as {source, observedAt, fiveHourPercent, weeklyPercent, extraUsageEnabled} and a timezone-aware clock, and returns a frozen QuotaDecision with proceed, a fixed reason, an immutable evidence mapping (readings, deltas, cohort state after the unit) and executionAuthorization false. A fresh pre-reading within every cap proceeds with reason within-caps; every T004 negative control refuses with its own fixed reason.
